svg.font-family: Inter, "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Architecture of the highly available web platform (derived from the Terraform in this repository)
svg.desc: Configured design, not live telemetry. A viewer resolves the name through Route 53, connects to CloudFront over HTTPS, which forwards over HTTP with a secret header through the internet gateway to the external ALB. The ALB forwards to the frontend Auto Scaling group in private subnets, which calls the internal ALB, then the backend Auto Scaling group, which queries a Multi-AZ RDS PostgreSQL database in isolated subnets. Two Availability Zones, one NAT gateway per zone.
